name: HMIS106A_HIV_CARE_ART HPV
description:
HPV01b. Children active on ART with Completed HPV vaccination status
Number of children who are active on ART and have a documented HPV vaccination status of Completed, indicating completion of the HPV vaccination schedule.
The patient must be active in ART care, defined as having an ART encounter between :startDate and :endDate or having a return_visit_date extending beyond :endDate. The patient must have an ART-card encounter during the reporting quarter with hpvVacStatus = 'COMPLETED'. Each patient is counted once.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f

      "name": "HPV01c: Complete vaccination (doses 1 & 2)",
      "sortOrder": 1,
      "sql": {
        "compiled": "WITH base_pop AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT art.client_id AS client_id FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card art
  WHERE art.encounter_date >= :startDate AND art.encounter_date < :endDate
    AND art.hpvVacStatus = "Complete"
),
ag AS (
  SELECT
    ag.age_group_id,
    ag.label,
    ag.min_age_days,
    ag.max_age_days,
    ag.sort_order
  FROM report_builder_dim_age_group ag
  JOIN report_builder_dim_age_category ac
    ON ac.age_category_id = ag.age_category_id
  WHERE ac.code = 'HMIS_106A'
    AND ag.is_active = 1
),
genders AS (
  SELECT 'F' AS gender
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'M' AS gender
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT
    ag.age_group_id AS age_group_id,
    mdp.gender AS gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT base_pop.client_id) AS value
  FROM base_pop
  JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
    ON mdp.client_id = base_pop.client_id
  JOIN ag
    ON TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, mdp.birthdate, :endDate)
       BETWEEN ag.min_age_days AND ag.max_age_days
  WHERE mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IN ('F','M')
  GROUP BY ag.age_group_id, mdp.gender
)
SELECT
  ag.label AS age_group,
  g.gender AS gender,
  COALESCE(cnt.value, 0) AS value
FROM ag
CROSS JOIN genders g
LEFT JOIN cnt
    ON cnt.age_group_id = ag.age_group_id
   AND cnt.gender = g.gender
ORDER BY ag.sort_order, g.gender;",
